feature: CodeBlockView re-highlights syntax on every expand/collapse toggle
workflow_rationale: Single-file trivial fix (one-line change) already applied prior to task creation. Workflow is verification-only.

phases.name: Verify Fix
phases.description: Confirm that the syntax re-highlighting bug is already fixed in the codebase and the iOS build compiles successfully.

subtasks.description: Confirm fix is applied: verify .task(id:) in CodeBlockView.swift does NOT include isExpanded
subtasks.notes: Verified: .task(id:) in CodeBlockView.swift uses only code.hashValue and language — does NOT include isExpanded. Fix was already applied. Line 230: .task(id: "\(code.hashValue)-\(language ?? "")"). Syntax highlighting only re-runs when code content or language changes.
subtasks.expected_output: Line 230 of CodeBlockView.swift reads: .task(id: "\(code.hashValue)-\(language ?? "")") — confirming isExpanded is absent

verification.expected: Only one match; the id string must NOT contain 'isExpanded'

subtasks.description: Build iOS target to confirm no compilation errors were introduced by the fix
subtasks.notes: iOS build succeeded with ** BUILD SUCCEEDED **. No compilation errors. The fix (removing isExpanded from .task(id:) key in CodeBlockView.swift) compiles cleanly.

summary.investigation_findings: The bug described in the spec (isExpanded included in .task(id:) key) was already fixed in commit 65e249d before this task was created. The fix consists of three improvements: (1) init() pre-computes syntax highlighting synchronously so no flash on first render; (2) .task(id: code.hashValue+language) refreshes only when code/language changes — NOT on isExpanded toggle; (3) collapsed view uses .lineLimit() on the full AttributedString instead of re-slicing displayedLines.
summary.startup_command: N/A — verification only, no services to start

acceptance_criteria: .task(id:) key in CodeBlockView.swift does not contain isExpanded

verification_steps.name: Grep verification
verification_steps.expected_outcome: id string contains only code.hashValue and language

verification_strategy.reasoning: Trivial risk — the fix is a well-understood single-line change removing isExpanded from a task modifier key. Already applied and should only need build verification.
